work: STEP 10.5 — G7 real agent-directed destination closure
headline: The navigation blocker (N2) is FIXED and proven on the real runtime: run 2 executed the complete real route and produced a genuine LISTING@0.99 observation. G7 is nevertheless still OPEN because the run needs a FOURTH provider call and the configured Groq tier serves three per minute with no usable fallback. DestinationVerifier MATCH, subgoal completion, planner progression and GoalVerifier were therefore never reached inside a live run.

labels.verifierOnCapturedObservation: PROVEN_UNIT_ONLY — the production verifier run against the observation a real run actually captured

N1_model_lacked_destination_intent.evidence: declaredDestination={provenance:USER_DECLARED_DESTINATION, role:[LISTING]} present in 100% of captured request bodies across every run, on every turn including turns where a different subgoal was active.

N2_model_ignored_destination_intent.before: Step 10.4 run: on search.html the model received role=[LISTING] plus an ENTER_QUERY affordance and replied 'No catalog or listing link is visible on the current search page; scrolling down may reveal...' then scrolled -> ACTION_NO_EFFECT.
N2_model_ignored_destination_intent.fix: Part 6: a positive, role-parameterised navigation instruction added to the model-facing declaration block in backend/app/reasoner.py. No authority, no URL, no fixture knowledge.
N2_model_ignored_destination_intent.after: Run 2 executed click btn-shop-now -> type 'all' into input-search-query -> click btn-search-submit, reaching results.html.

N3_model_lacked_destination_affordance.evidence: On search.html the payload carried detections [btn-search-submit, input-search-query, inter-link-1] and affordances [ENTER_QUERY, SUBMIT_SEARCH, FILL_FIELD, SUBMIT_FORM, SCROLL]. On / the Browse Catalog link was present as detection btn-shop-now.

N4_planner_failed_to_act_on_destination_.evidence: The planner correctly selected sg1 (NAVIGATE / DESTINATION_VERIFIED) every run and correctly REFUSED to complete it while the page was UNKNOWN. It never mis-completed.

N5_targetResolver_selected_wrong_target.evidence: The click on btn-shop-now produced the correct navigation to /search.html in every run where it was issued.

N6_fixture_exposes_ambiguous_navigation.evidence: Fixture audit: / has Browse Catalog; /search.html has whose form navigates to results.html?q=...; /results.html carries 4 product-card elements and classifies LISTING@0.99 via the production classifier. The route is two hops of real observable affordances.

N7_provider_or_model_limitation.evidence: Groq returns HTTP 429 with an explicit budget message: 'Rate limit reached for model openai/gpt-oss-20b ... on tokens per minute (TPM): Limit 8000, Used 6505, Requested 2372'. Measured: limit 8000 TPM, each agent call requests ~2200-2600 prompt tokens, therefore exactly 3 calls fit per minute. The G7 chain needs 4 (click, type, submit, verify). The configured fallback OpenRouter fails with HTTP 402 'Insufficient credits. This account never purchased credits.' NVIDIA times out after 30s. MAX_LLM_ATTEMPTS=1, so there is no retry.

N8_action_execution_defect.evidence: Every issued action executed correctly; completedSteps showed click, type and click all landing.

N9_observation_or_classification_defect.evidence: The production classifier returns LISTING@0.99 on the real /results.html DOM (verified with the real classifier against the live fixture), UNKNOWN@0.1 on / and on /search.html. All correct.

providerCapacityAudit.primary: groq / openai/gpt-oss-20b (served model observed; the STRONG role maps to gpt-oss-120b)
providerCapacityAudit.callsAccounting: Per agent step the extension calls POST /api/v1/agent/action (REAL provider call) and POST /api/v1/agent/review (LOCAL DETERMINISTIC — returns {'safe': true, 'reason': 'Safety review passed (deterministic).'}). So there is ONE provider call per step, not two. A Step 10.4 statement of 'two provider calls per step' was WRONG and is corrected here.

fallback.openrouter: configured and reachable, but HTTP 402 'Insufficient credits. This account never purchased credits.'

providerCapacityAudit.rootCause: TEST-ENVIRONMENT CAPACITY — a free-tier TPM budget of 8000 with ~2400 tokens per agent prompt mathematically admits 3 calls, and the chain needs 4.
providerCapacityAudit.productionImpact: Any multi-step agent task needing 4+ provider calls inside one minute terminates with a fail-closed 503. This is not a destination defect.

additionalFindingsNotFixed.finding: The agent loop treats a retryable:true HTTP 422 (unknown_target) as terminal instead of recovering via the REPERCEIVE strategy it already has.
additionalFindingsNotFixed.why: Pre-existing failure-recovery gap, not a destination issue; fixing it would change agentLoop recovery behaviour, which is outside Step 10.5's scope.

additionalFindingsNotFixed.finding: MODEL_NAVIGATION variance: the model sometimes proposes a semantic affordance id as an action target (affordance-scroll-1), which target grounding correctly refuses.
additionalFindingsNotFixed.why: Model variance, not a production defect. The refusal is correct fail-closed behaviour.

additionalFindingsNotFixed.finding: The prompt never stated the 300-character reason limit that _enforce_field_limits already enforces.
additionalFindingsNotFixed.why: FIXED in Step 10.5 by stating the existing limit. MAX_REASON_CHARS was NOT raised and the validator was NOT weakened.

g7Acceptance.verdict: G7 OPEN — the first eleven are PROVEN_REAL, the last five are NOT_REACHED. The chain stops one provider call short.
